<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-INS-001</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Installation and upgrade</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Platform Manager **Network ports** page; Docker start-up</b></div></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Already in use: 8080. Choose another port, or stop what is listening on it.</span></div>

## Why it happens

Another program, or an earlier SENTIENT, already listens on the port. Common holders are another web server on 8080 and an earlier PostgreSQL on 5432.

## Fix it

- Platform Manager: choose another port on the **Network ports** page.
- Docker: change the left-hand number of the port mapping in the compose file, for example `"8090:8080"`.

To see what holds the port, run `netstat -ano | findstr :8080` on Windows or `ss -tlnp | grep 8080` on Linux.

## Check that it worked

The port shows as free in Platform Manager, or the container starts.
